messages:
Priya: quick proposal — want to run a customer-preview for the new routing + model-variant feature. idea: tenant opt-in cohorts, staged by region, with a soft-fail fallback to baseline model and an automated circuit-breaker. need launch criteria, SLO checks, and a short rollback playbook. opinions? :eyes:

Jon: SGTM. couple engineering constraints: (1) deterministic sampling per session/tenant so we don’t flip users mid-conversation, (2) clear telemetry hooks for drift vs baseline outputs. also need an API to set per-tenant sample rates.

Eli: SRE + reliability notes: we should have auto-rollback triggers. suggestion: rollback if error_rate > 2% OR p95 latency increases > 30% sustained over 5m. also prefer region-level thresholds. can we expose a `cohort_error` metric per tenant/region?

Priya: agreed. proposed canary schedule: start at 0.5% of a region's traffic, double every 30m to 8%, then open to 25% for opt-ins. enterprise tenants get manual opt-in. also need audit trail and SLA language for preview customers.

Sam: customer request: Acme wants to be in the first cohort. they asked for guaranteed fallback and an audit log entry for every toggle. can we do per-tenant opt-in now?

Maya: yes we can add audit events. CLI/SDK surface idea: `ri flags enable --tenant=acme --flag=preview-routing --sample=0.005`

ops-bot: Deploy scheduled: feature-flag-service v2 -> canary on infra-02 at 1718389200 :rocket:

Jon: implementation detail — deterministic hashing library using `hash(tenant_id + salt) % 1e6` to map into sample buckets. suggest config schema like:
```
{
  "flag": "preview-routing",
  "salt": "2026-03-21-preview",
  "sample_rate": 0.005,
  "scope": "region:us-west-2",
  "fallback": "baseline-v1",
  "rollback_triggers": {
    "p95_latency_pct_increase": 30,
    "error_rate_pct": 2,
    "window_seconds": 300
  }
}
```

Eli: +1. Also: warm the KV cache and prefetch top prefixes for the new model variant to avoid an initial latency spike. add a warmup job that fires once per new rollout.

Priya: launch checklist (high level): docs & comms, SDK flagging API, telemetry dashboards (per-tenant p95, error_rate, quality_regression), rollback playbook, customer opt-in flow, legal/data-residency sign-off.

Sam: :thumbsup: I'll coordinate with Acme and get the commercial/legal ok. will confirm NDA and what data (if any) is shared with them.

Maya: question — do we want shadow A/B evals? my recommendation: optional shadow comparator that sends candidate outputs to the quality-eval pipeline (offline) and emits `quality_regression` signal if mismatch > threshold. flag parameter `shadow: true` to enable.

Priya: yes make shadowing optional but easy to enable per-tenant.

Jon: client-facing graceful degrade: when fallback happens, stream a header `X-RI-Fallback: baseline-v1` so product can surface a small banner. also emit an event to audit logs.

Eli: ops note — incidentbot will auto-page if cohort_error > 5% for > 10m. also create a regional partial-fallback runbook (steps to force flip, revoke, and re-run warmup).

Priya: owners: Eli -> SRE thresholds & runbook, Jon -> flag API + sampling lib, Maya -> audit + CLI, Sam -> customer coordination. I’ll draft the rollout doc with the timeline. target soft-launch in 2 weeks. :calendar:

Maya: :raised_hands: I can take CLI + audit events.

Jon: I’ll open the sampling PR and add the config schema.

Eli: I’ll draft the runbook and add the auto-rollback monitors.

Priya: thanks team. action items recorded. I’ll share the rollout doc by EOD tomorrow and ping for feedback.

Sam: will notify Acme and confirm dates.

ops-bot: Note: feature-flag-service v2 canary completed on infra-02 at 1718389255 :white_check_mark:
